name: Agent Bits
description: Small, reliable utilities and datasets for AI agents.

capabilities.name: countries
capabilities.description: Versioned curated country metadata dataset used by country_lookup and countries_bulk.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use when an agent needs ISO country metadata as a dataset rather than invoking a single lookup.
limitations: Single-country lookup via country_lookup remains free.

capabilities.name: countries_bulk
capabilities.description: Retrieve the full versioned countries dataset used by Agent Bits country lookups. Use when an agent needs bulk offline country metadata rather than a single country lookup.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need the complete countries dataset for a specific version (for caching, offline use, or multi-country analysis) instead of looking up one country code at a time.
limitations: Paid capability. Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 / payment challenge.
Returns the curated Agent Bits countries dataset, not a live feed.

capabilities.name: country_lookup
capabilities.description: Look up metadata for an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Use this when an agent needs a country's name, currency, language, calling code, region, or related standardized country metadata.
capabilities.when_to_use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a country identified by an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example CA, US, JP), including common name, official name, region, currency, calling code, or languages.
limitations: Accepts ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes only in v1.
Dataset is a curated subset/versioned snapshot, not a live geopolitical feed.
